title: Normalized localization of internal-section tensors, globally and on slices
statement: Let \(X\) be a scheme and \(\Lambda\) a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Let \(B\) be its pulled-back coefficient monoid on the pro-étale site \(\mathcal C=X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}\), let \(B_{\mathrm{sec}}\) be its reconstructed sheaf of section rings, and let \(F:\operatorname{Mod}(B)\simeq\operatorname{Mod}(B_{\mathrm{sec}})\) be the section-action equivalence [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, def-sfb-internal-section-total-comparison]. Write \(H\) for the unbounded ringed-site K-injective derived internal Hom. There exist a closed tensor structure \(S\) with internal Hom \(H\), K-flat representative tensor models \(T\) for \(S\), and a natural isomorphism \[D(F)(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{B}L)\simeq D(F)K\otimes_S D(F)L.\] Its representative square is the specified predicate \(\mathrm{tensorComparisonNormalized}\), using the fixed signed sum-total comparison \(\mathrm{totalComparison}\) [def-sfb-internal-section-derived-tensor-comparison, def-sfb-internal-section-total-comparison]. For every object \(U\in\mathcal C\), the same existence assertion holds on \(\mathcal C/U\) for the actual restricted monoid \(B|_U\), the literal ring \(B_{\mathrm{sec}}|_U\), its ringed-site derived internal Hom, and the derived section equivalence. Its representative square is \(\mathrm{sliceTensorComparisonNormalized}\) for the fixed \(\mathrm{sliceTotalComparison}\) [def-sfb-internal-slice-derived-hom-comparison]. The global and local structures need not be chosen compatibly under restriction; this statement asserts only these normalized tensor comparisons.

proof.text: Take the ringed closed structure and representative tensor models from the native tensor-Hom adjunction, retaining their equality with the native derived monoidal structure and comparison. For complexes whose section images are K-flat, cancel the invertible target localization tensorator; its inverse is the fixed representative comparison. This yields the prescribed normalization with the total map from Step 1.

proof.text: Repeat the ordinary and derived tensor construction for the actual restricted coefficient ring on each slice. Transport the construction across the equality between its reconstructed section ring and the literal restriction. The explicit slice total map is heterogeneously equal to the shared generic total comparison, so the same normalized descent produces SliceTensorComparison with the prescribed square. Use sliceEquivalence_functor_heq and sliceTotalComparison_heq to retain both concrete transports without expanding their constructions. A private generic record stores the closed structure, tensor models, comparison iso and square; the iso depends only on the closed structure, while its normalization also depends on the models. Its generic elimination lemma produces the required existential packages.

lean.statement:
theorem internalSection_tensorLocalization :
    (∃ (S : CoefficientClosedStructure (hom Λ X))
      (T : CoefficientTensorModels.{u, u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ring Λ X) S),
      Nonempty (TensorComparison Λ X S T)) ∧
    (∀ U : X.ProEt,
      ∃ (S : CoefficientClosedStructure
          (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{u + 1, u, u, u + 1}
            ((Scheme.ProEt.topology X).over U) ((ring Λ X).over U)))
        (T : CoefficientTensorModels.{u, u + 1, u, u + 1}
          ((Scheme.ProEt.topology X).over U) ((ring Λ X).over U) S),
        Nonempty (SliceTensorComparison Λ X U S T))
